overview_description.description: Unstable Protocol is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform that allows users to borrow against staked cryptocurrency assets while retaining staking rewards. The protocol uses over-collateralized positions to issue its native stablecoin, nUSD, and generates revenue through borrowing fees. It also supports collateral verification and cross-chain functionality through blockchain infrastructure and partner integrations.
